comment: This label helps identify the provider in logs, configurations and maps credentials to the provider.
The AI provider deployment type.
The possible values are: 'saas' (for WatsonX.ai SaaS) or 'lightweightengine' (for WatsonX.ai Lightweight Engine).
This value is automatically set based on your selection during gather mode.
The AI provider service endpoint used by Content Cortex AI Services.
For SaaS: Example 'https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com'
For Lightweight Engine: Your on-premise WatsonX endpoint
The username for authenticating with the AI provider.
Required for: Lightweight Engine (WLE) deployment
Not used for: SaaS deployment (will be ignored if DEPLOYMENT_TYPE is 'saas')
The API key for authenticating with the AI provider.
Required for: Both SaaS and Lightweight Engine deployments
The space ID used by the AI provider.
Required for: SaaS deployment only
For SaaS: Provide either SPACE_ID or PROJECT_ID (not both required)
For Lightweight Engine: Leave empty (not used)
Leave empty if using PROJECT_ID instead.
The project ID used by the AI provider.
Required for: SaaS deployment only
For SaaS: Provide either SPACE_ID or PROJECT_ID (not both required)
For Lightweight Engine: Leave empty (not used)
Leave empty if using SPACE_ID instead.
Enable or disable Redis for Content Cortex AI Services.
The possible values are: 'true' or 'false'. Default value is 'false'.
